versions.changelog: Add the required skill card and keep memory operations tool-scoped with a guarded manual fallback.
Harden endpoint handling, declare least-privilege tool scope, and use the Lethe plugin tools for agent-turn memory operations.
Tighten Lethe memory skill guidance and reduce prompt footprint.

lethe 0.1.8

- Clarified Lethe server must only run locally—do not expose externally.
- Improved session handling: sessions must be created dynamically via the API when not found; removed hardcoded/fallback session IDs to avoid event mixing.
- Updated skill notes to specify local CLI path (`lethe-log` is in the root skill directory, not under scripts/).
- Added explicit warning that setting LETHE_API will send data off-machine (reserved for a future SaaS mode).
- Documentation and startup instructions updated for clarity and accurate API usage.
Add memory_search tool, clarify plugin auto-handling, update proactive recall to prefer native tools over curl/CLI

- Added detailed metadata to clarify environment requirements, including Docker and CLI usage notes.
- Updated metadata to include support for Docker-based installations and future SaaS environments.
- Described that SESSION_KEY is injected automatically and LETHE_API is for future use.
- Noted that Docker is required for running the Lethe server and explained the location and role of the lethe-log CLI.
- No changes to core logic or usage flow. Documentation and environment clarification only.

lethe-memory v1.0.0 — Initial release introducing persistent, session-spanning memory for AI agents.

- Provides a universal memory layer for recording, querying, and recalling decisions, tasks, and flags across sessions.
- Automatic orientation: retrieves prior context, open threads, and unresolved flags at session start.
- Proactive memory search before answering historical or context-based questions.
- Comprehensive event recording (decisions, observations, flags, tasks) using the lethe-log tool.
- Flags management system surfaces uncertainties needing human attention.
- Supersedes scratch pads and MEMORY.md files as the agent’s authoritative memory source.
